population_or_model: Refractory ACC progressing after mitotane and 1-3 cytotoxic chemotherapies
treatment_and_comparator: Sunitinib monotherapy 50 mg/day (4 weeks on, 2 weeks off); single-arm, no comparator
outcome_numbers: 5/35 stable disease, 24 progressive disease, 6 died before first evaluation; response (PFS>=12 weeks) 14.3% naive / 15.4% median-unbiased (95% CI 5.0-33.4%); median PFS 2.8 months; negative correlation between sunitinib+SU12662 and mitotane levels (r=-0.650, P=0.114)
reviewer_notes: Direct monotherapy trial, but the authors report a major pharmacokinetic confounder (mitotane-induced CYP3A4 lowering sunitinib exposure) and describe activity as modest and comparing favourably with other targeted agents, so the direction is not unambiguously negative. Protocol criterion 4 is not met. Flagged for adjudication as a genuine judgement call.
